GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, held its own ground in Straight # Had Every Chance
Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 7th Outside 7 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths to Straightening Up clear run home Outside 6th @ 300m, 2nd x 50m, # Sound chase
Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down last 11 Lengths within 8 Lengths x 600m went wide clear run home Kept Finding Closest on line, # gave em 11 l.
Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down 8th Inside 6 Lengths held-up x 800m eased off heels got to Outside x Turn clear run home 6th x 300m, Kept Trying Closest on line (t/t/1st) # ran on evenly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Over raced in the middle stages when the pace of the race slackened.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th 5 Lengths but too keen lay out and saddle slipped - pu/p x 1200m - # keen/hung sad slip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the winning post on the first occasion, commenced to over-race and at a point near the 1600m, commenced to hang out. Continued to do so resulting in the saddle shifting forward at a point near the 1300m. Jockey J. Bayliss then restrained the mare out of the event. Trainer P. Jenkins was advised EVADE THE GAME would be required to Officially trial to the satisfaction of Stewards prior to racing again. Trainer P. Jenkins advised stewards that the horse would now be sent for a spell and he would experiment with the horse’s gear prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , circled forward and Two Wide Outside Lead at 1400m, went past at 1000m, led out by 4 Lengths at the 800m, came back to lead 1 length turning, Headed 275m and Lost Ground in the run home. [Stewards questioned rider re performance and tactics adopted. Jockey reported intending to settle midfield with cover, however it was caught Wide and inclined to overrace early/middle stages, therefore he allowed it to stride forward to a leading position mid-race. He added it was inclined to lay out.] # Had a tough run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported intention to obtain a midfield position with cover, however, mount was caught wide and inclined to over race in the early and middle stages, therefore allowed to stride to a leading position in the middle stages-added mount was also inclined to lay out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down last 9 - 10 Lengths ridden quiet @ rear to Straightening Up went wide x 300m chimed in x 100m - # cold ride, good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages. Had difficulty obtaining clear running on entering the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay then inconvenienced and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide at 1200m, Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, lost a length in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inconvenienced at the start. Raced wide until approaching the 1200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Knuckled on jumping, unbalancing rider, missed start 1 length and Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 7 Lengths turning, Held Up 500m-300m then shifted out and Made Ground in straight. (Tongue Control Bit FIRST TIME) # missed start/ok run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Knuckled on leaving the barriers, unbalancing rider and losing ground. Held up for a run from passing the 500m until near the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 750m and Made Some Ground to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and made a little ground in Straight # Wide last 750m
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 1050m, Moved Up to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight as the quinella pair raced away # Wide early
Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths 9th x Turn asked to go at the 400m kept trying without threatening - # not quick enough
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced early and passing the 900m, steadied after improving onto heels. Laid out under pressure in the home straight. Passing 300m was momentarily inconvenienced and steadied to avoid heels.
